entries.answer: Offside is judged when a teammate plays/touches the ball. In the opponents’ half, a playable body part must be nearer the goal line than BOTH the ball and second-last opponent; level is onside. Position alone is not an offence: the player must become involved, such as receiving that pass or interfering with an opponent. No offside directly from a goal kick, throw-in or corner. This is an illustration, not a verdict on the film.

visual.description: Schematic at a teammate’s touch: level with the second-last opponent is onside; ahead of both opponent and ball is an offside position. Receiving the pass demonstrates involvement. A glove marks the goalkeeper; not a verdict on the film.

entries.answer: Alisson is King Aldric's brother and Princess Lyra's uncle through her father. We now know he was not running away: he secretly met Captain Bren, gave him a note, and pointed at the Chancellor's tower. Those actions are revealed, but they do not establish exactly why his earlier council chair was empty.
